verdict.rationale: EFTPS offers a free Batch Provider Software channel and lets tax professionals make payments for multiple clients under a single login, which implies batch submission of many payments. The evidence is only a one-line mention, though, and the documented software channel is a separate batch program rather than an API: OpenAPI and llms.txt probes all return 404. missing for 10: documentation of what batch operations are supported (bulk scheduling, change or cancel), any programmatic or API-driven bulk interface, details on batch file formats or limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
